name: Saotome Kana
source:
She is a great friend of Miu's and lives nearby.

She often comes over to our house and has stayed over a few times. By the way, she is a beautiful girl who looks as good as Miu when they walk side by side.
In contrast to the calm Miu, she is a cool-feeling girl.

She is about the same height as Miu and is petite. They look like an idol unit when they stand side by side. Also, I should mention that she has big tits, which is something that cannot be avoided when talking about her appearance.
